rules: Each template line is one output line. A {name} placeholder takes a value already made terminal-safe by the renderer (native limits and native configuration are canonical JSON). A line starting with ? is printed without the ? when every placeholder in it has a value, and omitted otherwise. A line starting with * repeats once per item of its single list placeholder (none for an empty list). Every printed line ends with a line feed.
